description: Test cases for architecture DESIGN, 5-Zone AUDIT, Hierarchy VALIDATION, and RESOLVE routes

test_cases.input: Workspace path with all 5 zones present but .context/domain/ contains a methodology file (data placement violation)
test_cases.expected_output: Zone paths: all PASS. Data placement: 1 CRITICAL violation — methodology file in .context/. Recommendation: Move to KB/domain/.
test_cases.pass_criteria: All zone paths checked against 5-zone-audit-checklist.md, data placement scan detects contamination, severity correctly classified as Critical

test_cases.description: Hierarchy validation detecting orphan SI file
test_cases.input: .agents/agents.md roster with 5 agents. .agents/agents/ contains 7 .md files (2 orphans not in roster).
test_cases.expected_output: Roster check: PASS (5/5 files exist). Orphan check: WARNING — 2 files not in roster. Lists orphan filenames with recommendation.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Correctly cross-references roster to physical files, detects both orphans, classifies as Warning not Critical

test_cases.description: T3↔T3 direct communication must be flagged as Critical
test_cases.input: .agents/agents.md Interaction Matrix cell [W01][W02] = 'Direct handoff' instead of '❌ (Via COORD)'
test_cases.expected_output: CRITICAL: T3↔T3 direct communication violation between W01 and W02. Strict routing rule violated. Recommend SR6 repair.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Agent detects non-ban marker in T3↔T3 cell, classifies as Critical, recommends SR6 protocol

test_cases.description: Fix missing zone directories with proper structure
test_cases.input: 5-Zone audit finding: Missing artifacts/handoffs/, missing .agents/tests/, missing tmp/
test_cases.expected_output: SR1 applied: 3 directories created. Critical (artifacts/handoffs/) created first, then Warning (tests/, tmp/). Re-scan shows 0 missing.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Directories created in severity order, parent directories auto-created, verification scan passes

test_cases.description: Architecture skill must NOT create Agent SI content — delegate to rules
test_cases.input: Finding: .agents/agents/ is empty (SR3). User says 'fix it — generate agent files'.
test_cases.expected_output: Architecture creates directory structure only. Delegates Agent SI content creation to rules skill: 'Agent SI content is rules skill scope. I created the folder structure. Delegate to rules Route 1 for SI generation.'
test_cases.pass_criteria: Agent refuses to write SI content, correctly identifies scope boundary, delegates to rules skill

test_cases.input: SCOPE Brief: Team of 8 managing an e-commerce platform. Processes: Order management, Inventory tracking, Customer support, Reporting.
test_cases.expected_output: Value Chain: 4-step process. Functional Groups: 3-4 departments (Operations, Customer Success, Analytics + Coordinator). Interaction Matrix: T3↔T3 blocked. Blueprint with diagrams.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Minimum 3 Functional Groups (Execution + QA + Coordinator), Interaction Matrix enforces T3 routing, Value Chain covers all 4 processes
